critical_code_review_comments: The readLibrary/publishLibrary shared array and the partFolder/parseFilename caches hand the same object to every caller. No caller mutates them today (checked tmdbMatcher, fixMissing, multiPart, LocalLibraryPage, StatsPage: they all copy with spreads/map). A future in-place mutation would corrupt the cache; consider Object.freeze in dev builds.

The partFolder cache key is the path only. This is correct because computePartFolder depends only on the path plus showRoots, and the cache is cleared whenever the showRoots signature changes. The type-switch test confirms this.
React runs passive unmount cleanups before new mount effects, so Stats reads the flushed library after an immediate navigation. Verified.
